Lift the ban on asylum seekers working if they have been waiting for a decision for more than three months, enabling them to support themselves, integrate in their communities and contribute to the economy.

policies.policy_title: Expand Youth Mobility Scheme
policies.stated: Expand the Youth Mobility Scheme by negotiating with the EU for reciprocal extension, increasing the age limit from 30 to 35, abolishing visa fees, and extending visa length from two to three years.

source.quote: Expand the Youth Mobility Scheme by: Negotiating with the EU to extend it on a reciprocal basis. Increasing the age limit from 30 to 35. Abolishing the fees for these visas. Extending the length of visas from two to three years.

policies.policy_title: Reverse Unfair Increase to Family Visa Income Thresholds
policies.stated: Reverse the Conservatives’ unfair increase to income thresholds for family visas, ensuring that families are not torn apart by complex and restrictive requirements.

source.quote: Reverse the Conservatives’ unfair increase to income thresholds for family visas, so that no more families are torn apart.

policies.policy_title: Repeal Discriminatory 'Right to Rent' Scheme
policies.stated: Repeal the Conservatives’ discriminatory ‘Right to Rent’ scheme that turns landlords into border guards, and establish a firewall to prevent public agencies from sharing personal information with the Home Office for immigration enforcement.

source.quote: Repeal the Conservatives’ discriminatory ‘Right to Rent’ scheme that turns landlords into border guards. Establish a firewall to prevent public agencies from sharing personal information with the Home Office for the purposes of immigration enforcement and repeal the immigration exemption in the Data Protection Act.

policies.policy_title: End Immigration Detention of Children and Limit Adult Detention
policies.stated: End the detention of children for immigration purposes, and reduce detention for adults to an absolute last resort, with a 28-day time limit for adult detention.

source.quote: End the detention of children for immigration purposes, and reduce detention for adults to an absolute last resort, with a 28-day time limit.

policies.policy_title: Champion Human Rights Act
policies.stated: Champion the Human Rights Act and resist any attempts to weaken or repeal it, upholding the UK’s commitment to the European Convention on Human Rights and resisting any attempts to withdraw from it.

source.quote: Champion the Human Rights Act and resist any attempts to weaken or repeal it. Upholding the UK’s commitment to the European Convention on Human Rights and resisting any attempts to withdraw from it.

policies.policy_title: Comprehensive Race Equality Strategy
policies.stated: Develop and implement a comprehensive Race Equality Strategy to address deep inequalities across education, health, criminal justice, and the economy, including reducing maternal mortality for black women, ending disproportionate Stop and Search, and implementing the Windrush Lessons Learned Review.

source.quote: Develop and implement a comprehensive Race Equality Strategy to address deep inequalities, including in education, health, criminal justice and the economy. Implement a comprehensive Race Equality Strategy, including: Reducing the disproportionately high maternal mortality rates for black women and eliminating racial disparities in maternal health, with a crossdepartmental target and strategy. Ending the disproportionate use of Stop and Search and requiring all police forces to adopt ambitious targets for improving the diversity of their workforce, as set out in chapter 11. Ending the Conservatives’ Hostile Environment, implementing the Windrush Lessons Learned Review and repealing the Conservatives’ discriminatory ‘Right to Rent’ law, as set out in chapter 18. Scrapping the Conservatives’ voter ID scheme and requiring political parties to publish candidate diversity data, as set out in chapter 20. Halting the use of facial recognition surveillance, which is most likely to wrongly identify black people and women.

policies.policy_title: Make Misogyny a Hate Crime
policies.stated: Make misogyny a hate crime and give police and prosecutors the resources and training they need to prevent and prosecute all hate crimes while supporting survivors.

source.quote: Make misogyny a hate crime and give police and prosecutors the resources and training they need to prevent and prosecute all hate crimes while supporting survivors.

policies.policy_title: New Right to Flexible Working and Work from Home for Disabled People
policies.stated: Give everyone a new right to flexible working and every disabled person the right to work from home if they want to, unless there are significant business reasons why it is not possible.

source.quote: Give everyone a new right to flexible working and every disabled person the right to work from home if they want to, unless there are significant business reasons why it is not possible.

policies.policy_title: Protect LGBT+ Rights and Ban Conversion Therapies
policies.stated: Respect and defend the rights of people of all sexual orientations and gender identities, including trans and non-binary people, and ban all forms of conversion therapies and practices.

source.quote: Respect and defend the rights of people of all sexual orientations and gender identities, including trans and non-binary people. Ban all forms of conversion therapies and practices.

policies.policy_title: Scrap Draconian Anti-Protest Laws and Halt Facial Recognition Surveillance
policies.stated: Scrap the Conservatives’ draconian anti-protest laws, restoring pre-existing protections for peaceful assembly and public safety, and immediately halt the use of live facial recognition surveillance by police and private companies.

source.quote: Scrap the Conservatives’ draconian anti-protest laws, restoring preexisting protections for both peaceful assembly and public safety, and immediately halt the use of live facial recognition surveillance by the police and private companies.

policies.policy_title: New Right to Affordable Legal Assistance and Reform Legal Aid
policies.stated: Establish a new right to affordable, reasonable legal assistance, and make the Legal Aid system simpler, fairer, and more generous to ensure access to justice.

source.quote: Establishing a new right to affordable, reasonable legal assistance, and making the Legal Aid system simpler, fairer and more generous.

policies.policy_title: Introduce Digital Bill of Rights
policies.stated: Introduce a Digital Bill of Rights to protect everyone’s rights online, including privacy, free expression, and participation without harassment and abuse, along with a legally binding regulatory framework for biometric surveillance and ending bulk collection of communications data.

source.quote: Introducing a Digital Bill of Rights to protect everyone’s rights online, including the rights to privacy, free expression, and participation without being subjected to harassment and abuse. Ending the bulk collection of communications data and internet connection records. Introducing a legally binding regulatory framework for all forms of biometric surveillance.

policies.policy_title: End Gender Price Gap and Period Poverty
policies.stated: Tackle specific economic barriers facing women by ending the gender price gap (charging women more for identical products/services) and introducing a right for anyone who needs them to access free period products.

source.quote: Tackle the specific economic barriers facing women by: Ending the gender price gap so that women are not charged more than men for practically identical products or services marketed at them. Ending period poverty by introducing a right for anyone who needs them to access free period products.

policies.policy_title: Reform Gender Recognition Process
policies.stated: Reform the gender recognition process to remove the requirement for medical reports, recognize non-binary identities in law, and remove the spousal veto.

source.quote: Reform the gender recognition process to remove the requirement for medical reports, recognise non-binary identities in law, and remove the spousal veto.

policies.policy_title: Improve Diversity in Workplace and Public Life
policies.stated: Improve diversity in the workplace and public life by requiring large employers to monitor and publish data on diversity (gender, ethnicity, disability, LGBT+), extending name-blind recruitment, and setting ambitious diversity targets for public appointments.

source.quote: Improve diversity in the workplace and public life by: Requiring large employers to monitor and publish data on gender, ethnicity, disability, and LGBT+ employment levels, pay gaps and progression, and publish five-year aspirational diversity targets. Extending the use of name-blind recruitment processes in the public sector and encouraging their use in the private sector. Improving diversity in public appointments by setting ambitious targets and requiring progress reports to Parliament with explanations when targets are not met. Providing additional support and advice to employers on neurodiversity in the workplace, and developing a cross-government strategy to tackle all aspects of discrimination faced by neurodiverse children and adults.

policies.policy_title: New Accessibility Standards for Public Spaces and UN CRPD Incorporation
policies.stated: Make it easier for disabled people to access public life and work by adopting new accessibility standards for public spaces, improving blue badge legislative framework, and incorporating the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities into UK law.

source.quote: Make it easier for disabled people to access public life, including the world of work, by: Adopting new accessibility standards for public spaces. Improving the legislative framework for blue badges. Incorporating the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities into UK law.

policies.policy_title: Introduce Proportional Representation for MPs and Local Councillors
policies.stated: Introduce proportional representation by the Single Transferable Vote for electing MPs and local councillors in England, ensuring no politician can take voters for granted.

source.quote: Ensure no politician can take you for granted, by introducing proportional representation by the Single Transferable Vote for electing MPs, and local councillors in England.

policies.policy_title: Strengthen Democratic Rights and Participation
policies.stated: Strengthen democratic rights and participation by scrapping the Conservatives’ voter ID scheme and giving 16- and 17-year-olds the right to vote in UK general elections and referendums, and local elections in England.

source.quote: Strengthen democratic rights and participation by scrapping the Conservatives’ voter ID scheme and giving 16- and 17-year-olds the right to vote. Giving 16- and 17-year-olds the right to vote in UK general elections and referendums, and local elections in England.

policies.policy_title: Enshrine Ministerial Code in Legislation
policies.stated: Finally hold Government Ministers to account for corruption and sleaze by enshrining the Ministerial Code in legislation, and empowering the Adviser on Ministers’ Interests to initiate investigations and publish reports independently.

source.quote: Finally hold Government Ministers to account for corruption and sleaze by enshrining the Ministerial Code in legislation. Make the role of the Adviser on Ministers’ Interests truly independent by: Empowering them to initiate their own investigations, determine breaches and publish their report. Putting the role on a statutory basis and giving Parliament the power to appoint them.

policies.policy_title: Reform House of Lords with Democratic Mandate
policies.stated: Reform the House of Lords with a proper democratic mandate, aiming to repair damage from constant sleaze and neglect in the political system.

source.quote: Reform the House of Lords with a proper democratic mandate.

policies.policy_title: Transfer Powers from Westminster and Whitehall, Written Federal Constitution
policies.stated: Transfer greater powers away from Westminster and Whitehall, introduce a written constitution for a federal United Kingdom with strong voices for England, Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland, and oppose a second Scottish independence referendum and independence.

source.quote: Transfer greater powers away from Westminster and Whitehall, introduce a written constitution for a federal United Kingdom with strong voices for England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland, and oppose a second Scottish independence referendum and independence.

policies.policy_title: Cap Donations to Political Parties
policies.stated: Take big money out of politics by capping donations to political parties, aiming to make elections fairer and more transparent.

source.quote: Take big money out of politics by capping donations to political parties.

policies.policy_title: Strengthen Intelligence and Security Committee
policies.stated: Strengthen the Intelligence and Security Committee by giving it the power to decide what and when it publishes, and enabling the Houses of Parliament to elect its members.

source.quote: Strengthen the Intelligence and Security Committee by giving it the power to decide what it publishes and when, and enabling the Houses of Parliament to elect its members.

policies.policy_title: Protect Whistleblowers with Office of the Whistleblower
policies.stated: Protect whistleblowers by establishing a new Office of the Whistleblower, creating new legal protections, and promoting greater public awareness of their rights.

source.quote: Protecting whistleblowers by establishing a new Office of the Whistleblower, creating new legal protections, and promoting greater public awareness of their rights.

policies.policy_title: Reverse Conservative Army Cuts and Increase Defence Spending
policies.stated: Reverse the Conservative Government’s cut to the Army, with a longer-term ambition of increasing regular troop numbers back to over 100,000, and maintain the UK’s support for NATO by increasing defence spending every year, with an ambition to spend at least 2.5% of GDP on defence.

source.quote: Reversing the Conservative Government’s cut to the Army, with a longerterm ambition of increasing regular troop numbers back to over 100,000. Maintaining the UK’s support for NATO, and accordingly increasing defence spending in every year of the Parliament, with an ambition to spend at least 2.5% of GDP on defence.

policies.policy_title: Maintain Nuclear Deterrent While Pursuing Global Disarmament
policies.stated: Maintain the UK’s nuclear deterrent with four submarines providing continuous at-sea deterrence, while actively pursuing multilateral global disarmament.

source.quote: Maintaining the UK’s nuclear deterrent with four submarines providing continuous at-sea deterrence, while pursuing multilateral global disarmament.

policies.policy_title: Control Arms Exports to Countries with Poor Human Rights Records
policies.stated: Control arms exports to countries with poor human rights records by introducing a ‘presumption of denial’ for exports to governments listed as human rights concerns in the Foreign Office’s annual human rights report.

source.quote: Controlling arms exports to countries with poor human rights records. Introduce a ‘presumption of denial’ for arms exports to governments listed as human rights concerns in the Foreign Office’s annual human rights report.

policies.policy_title: Parliamentary Vote on Military Action
policies.stated: Legislate to ensure there is a parliamentary vote before engaging in military action, while preserving the government’s ability to act in emergencies with a retrospective vote or under treaty obligation.

source.quote: Legislate to ensure there is a parliamentary vote before engaging in military action, and support intervention only when there is a clear legal or humanitarian case, while preserving the government’s ability to engage in action in emergencies with a retrospective vote or under treaty obligation.

policies.policy_title: Strengthen Armed Forces Covenant and Improve MOD Housing
policies.stated: Secure a fair deal for service personnel and veterans by strengthening the Armed Forces Covenant with a legal duty on the Defence Secretary and government departments, and improving the standard of Ministry of Defence housing by reviewing maintenance contracts.

source.quote: Securing a fair deal for service personnel and veterans. Secure a fair deal for the armed forces community, and improve recruitment, retention and resettlement, by: Strengthening the Armed Forces Covenant by placing a legal duty on the Defence Secretary and government departments to give it due regard. Improving the standard of Ministry of Defence housing, including by reviewing maintenance contracts.

policies.policy_title: Work to Counter Global Rise in Authoritarianism
policies.stated: Work to counter the global rise in authoritarianism by championing the liberal, rules-based international order and supporting international institutions such as the United Nations, the Commonwealth, NATO, and the International Criminal Court.

source.quote: Work to counter the global rise in authoritarianism by championing the liberal, rules-based international order and supporting international institutions such as the United Nations, the Commonwealth, NATO and the International Criminal Court.

policies.policy_title: Stand with Ukraine Against Invasion
policies.stated: Stand with the people of Ukraine and provide them with the support that they need in the face of Putin’s illegal invasion, including the seizure of frozen Russian assets in the UK to finance support for Ukraine.

source.quote: Stand with the people of Ukraine and provide them with the support that they need in the face of Putin’s illegal invasion. Beginning the seizure of frozen Russian assets in the UK, with proceeds being repurposed to finance support for Ukraine, so that we can stand with Ukraine even if US support wavers.

policies.policy_title: Advocate for Immediate Bilateral Ceasefire in Israel-Gaza
policies.stated: Advocate for an immediate bilateral ceasefire in the Israel-Gaza conflict to resolve the humanitarian catastrophe in Gaza, get the hostages out, and provide space to reach a two-state solution based on 1967 borders with security and dignity for Israelis and Palestinians.

source.quote: Advocate for an immediate bilateral ceasefire in the Israel-Gaza conflict to resolve the humanitarian catastrophe in Gaza, get the hostages out, and provide the space to reach a two-state solution based on 1967 borders with security and dignity for Israelis and Palestinians.

policies.policy_title: Protect and Promote Human Rights Globally
policies.stated: Protect, defend, and promote human rights for all around the world by working to abolish the death penalty and torture, using Magnitsky sanctions, banning imports from areas with egregious abuses like Xinjiang, and developing a comprehensive strategy for decriminalizing homosexuality and advancing LGBT+ rights.

source.quote: Protect, defend and promote human rights for all around the world by: Working to abolish the death penalty and end the use of torture. Using the UK’s Magnitsky sanctions to stand up against human rights abuses. Banning imports from areas with egregious abuses such as Xinjiang. Enshrining in law a right for British nationals, including dual nationals, who have been politically detained or face other human rights violations abroad to access UK consular services. Developing a comprehensive strategy for promoting the decriminalisation of homosexuality and advancing LGBT+ rights. Appointing an ambassador-level Champion for Freedom of Belief.

policies.policy_title: Fund Impartial BBC World Service
policies.stated: Properly fund the impartial BBC World Service from the Foreign Office budget and restore its global reach to promote accurate information and democracy abroad.

source.quote: Properly fund the impartial BBC World Service from the Foreign Office budget and restore its global reach.

excluded.reason: Specific to Scotland's devolved powers, part of broader devolution principles, not a distinct material policy for UK-wide analysis.

Working more closely in the joint development of innovative defence technologies and procurement. Seeking a defence and security agreement with the EU and its member states. Continuing to work closely with our Five Eyes partners.

excluded.item: Fix the UK’s broken relationship with Europe by following our four-stage roadmap: Taking initial unilateral steps to rebuild the relationship, starting by declaring a fundamental change in the UK’s approach and improving channels for foreign policy cooperation. Deepening the trading relationship with critical steps for the British economy, including negotiating comprehensive veterinary and plant health agreements and mutual recognition agreements. Finally, once ties of trust and friendship have been renewed, and the damage the Conservatives have caused to trade between the UK and EU has begun to be repaired, we would aim to place the UK-EU relationship on a more formal and stable footing by seeking to join the Single Market. All these measures will help to restore the British economy and the prosperity and opportunities of its citizens, and are also essential steps on the road to EU membership, which remains our longer-term objective.
